name: School District U-46 Career and Technical Education pathways
what_you_do: Take a set of career classes in high school. Areas include business, health care, building and design, tech, and cooking and family life. Some classes add job training, real work time or college credit.
who_can_apply: Students at U-46 high schools. Educational Pathways start in 9th grade and do not need an application.
deadline_text: No application for Educational Pathways. Pick classes with your counselor when you plan your schedule.
how_to_apply: Talk to your school counselor. If your school does not have the class set you want, you can take it at another U-46 high school. You can also ask Doreen Roberts, who runs the career classes.
notes: Programs of Study differ by high school. Magnet Academies are a separate choice that students apply to in the fall of 8th grade. Student groups linked to CTE classes offer competitions and scholarships. District phone: 847-888-5000.
